Titel: Senior Performance Marketing Manager (f/m/d)
Unternehmen: Kiesel & Kraut Digital GmbH
Ort: Berlin (Deutschland)
Quelle: LinkedIn
Link: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4200001102/
Abgerufen am: 05.09.2026 07:30

About us
Kiesel & Kraut is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer brand for sustainable kitchenware, shipping to 11 European markets.

Your mission
Own our paid acquisition budget across Meta, Google and TikTok (EUR 6m per year)
Build a reliable KPI reporting and forecast for CAC, ROAS and contribution margin together with Finance
Drive the transformation of our attribution setup and lead our A/B testing roadmap
Steer two external agencies and work closely with stakeholders in Brand, CRM and Finance
Present the monthly performance review to the management board

What you bring
5+ years in performance marketing, ideally in e-commerce
Strong analytical skills, confident with Power BI or Looker, SQL is a plus
Experience in budget planning and controlling of marketing spend
Excellent stakeholder management and project management skills
Fluent English, German is a plus

What we offer
Permanent full-time contract
Salary range EUR 75,000 to 90,000 per year plus virtual shares
Hybrid setup with three office days in Berlin-Kreuzberg
30 days of vacation and up to four weeks of workation per year
